recipes.title: Smoked Mackerel Avocado Mash
recipes.ingredients:
• 160g Smoked Mackerel fillets
• 1 large Ripe Avocado
• 1 tbsp Fresh Lemon juice
• 1 tbsp Fresh Dill, chopped
• 1/2 tsp Cracked Black pepper
• 1/4 tsp Sea salt
recipes.instructions:
1. Remove the skin from the mackerel fillets and discard. 
2. Place the fish in a medium mixing bowl and use a fork to flake it into small pieces, checking carefully for any remaining small bones.
3. Halve the avocado, remove the stone, and scoop the flesh into the bowl with the fish.
4. Add the lemon juice, dill, salt, and pepper.
5. Mash the mixture together with a fork until you reach your desired consistency (chunky or smooth).
6. Serve immediately on keto-friendly toast or crisp lettuce leaves.

recipes.title: Flaxseed & Walnut N'Oats
recipes.ingredients:
• 30g Ground Flaxseed
• 20g Walnuts, roughly chopped
• 120ml Unsweetened Almond Milk
• 10g Chia Seeds
• 1/2 tsp Ground Cinnamon
• 5 drops Liquid Stevia (optional)
recipes.instructions:
1. In a small non-stick saucepan, combine the ground flaxseed, chia seeds, and almond milk.
2. Place over low-medium heat and stir continuously with a wooden spoon for 3-5 minutes.
3. Once the mixture has thickened to an oatmeal-like consistency, remove from the heat.
4. Stir in the cinnamon and stevia if using.
5. Transfer to a breakfast bowl and top with the chopped walnuts and an extra sprinkle of cinnamon.

recipes.title: Ultimate Tofu Spinach Scramble
recipes.ingredients:
• 200g Firm Tofu, pressed and drained
• 100g Fresh Baby Spinach
• 1 tbsp Nutritional Yeast
• 1/2 tsp Turmeric powder
• 1 tbsp Extra Virgin Olive Oil
• 1/2 tsp Garlic Powder
• Pinch of Himalayan Salt
recipes.instructions:
1. Use your hands or a fork to crumble the firm tofu into bite-sized pieces that resemble scrambled eggs.
2. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
3. Add the crumbled tofu to the pan and sauté for 3 minutes until slightly golden.
4. Stir in the turmeric, nutritional yeast, garlic powder, and salt, ensuring the tofu is evenly coated in the yellow color.
5. Add the fresh spinach to the pan. Cover with a lid for 1 minute to allow the spinach to wilt.
6. Remove the lid, stir everything together for one final minute, and serve hot.

recipes.title: Almond Flour Savory Pancakes
recipes.ingredients:
• 100g Fine Almond Flour
• 2 Large Eggs
• 50ml Unsweetened Almond Milk
• 1/2 tsp Baking Powder
• 1 tsp Dried Oregano
• 1 tbsp Avocado Oil (for frying)
recipes.instructions:
1. In a large bowl, whisk the eggs and almond milk together until well combined.
2. Sift in the almond flour, baking powder, and oregano.
3. Whisk until a smooth, thick batter forms. Let the batter rest for 2 minutes to allow the flour to hydrate.
4. Heat the avocado oil in a flat skillet over medium-low heat.
5. Pour small circles of batter (about 2 tablespoons each) onto the pan.
6. Cook for 2-3 minutes until small bubbles appear on the surface, then carefully flip.
7. Cook for another 2 minutes until golden brown on both sides.

recipes.title: Herb-Crusted Baked Cod fillets
recipes.ingredients:
• 300g Fresh Cod fillets
• 40g Blanched Almond Flour
• 1 tbsp Fresh Parsley, finely minced
• 1 tbsp Fresh Chives, snipped
• 1 tbsp Extra Virgin Olive Oil
• 1/2 Lemon, sliced into rounds
recipes.instructions:
1. Preheat your oven to 200°C (390°F) and line a baking dish with parchment paper.
2. In a shallow bowl, mix the almond flour, minced parsley, and chives.
3. Pat the cod fillets dry with a paper towel. This is crucial for a crispy crust.
4. Brush the top of each fillet with olive oil, then press the oiled side firmly into the almond flour herb mix.
5. Place the fillets in the baking dish, crust side up.
6. Arrange lemon slices around the fish and bake for 12-15 minutes, or until the fish flakes easily with a fork and the crust is golden.

recipes.title: Zesty Turkey Zucchini Stir-fry
recipes.ingredients:
• 300g Turkey breast strips
• 1 medium Zucchini, sliced into half-moons
• 1 Red Bell Pepper, thinly sliced
• 1 tbsp Toasted Sesame Oil
• 2 tbsp Coconut Aminos (or Soy Sauce)
• 1 tsp Fresh Ginger, grated
• 1 clove Garlic, minced
recipes.instructions:
1. Heat the sesame oil in a large wok or skillet over high heat until shimmering.
2. Add the turkey strips in a single layer. Sear for 3-4 minutes until cooked through and golden on the edges.
3. Remove the turkey from the pan and set aside.
4. Add the ginger and garlic to the remaining oil, stirring for 30 seconds until fragrant.
5. Toss in the zucchini and bell peppers. Stir-fry for 4-5 minutes until tender-crisp.
6. Return the turkey to the pan and pour over the coconut aminos.
7. Toss everything together for 1 minute and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Walnut-Crusted Tofu Steaks
recipes.ingredients:
• 250g Extra Firm Tofu
• 50g Walnuts, crushed into fine crumbs
• 1 tbsp Dijon Mustard
• 1 tsp Smoked Paprika
• 1 tbsp Olive Oil
recipes.instructions:
1. Cut the tofu block into 4 thick 'steaks' and press between paper towels to remove excess moisture.
2. In a small bowl, mix the crushed walnuts with the smoked paprika.
3. Use a pastry brush to coat one side of each tofu steak with a thin layer of Dijon mustard.
4. Press the mustard side of the tofu into the walnut mixture until heavily coated.
5. Heat olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
6. Place the tofu in the pan, walnut side down first. Cook for 4 minutes until the nuts are toasted and fragrant.
7. Carefully flip and cook the other side for 3 minutes.

recipes.title: Keto Golden Flax Bread
recipes.ingredients:
• 200g Ground Golden Flaxseed
• 5 Large Eggs
• 100ml Filtered Water
• 3 tbsp Avocado Oil
• 1 tbsp Baking Powder
• 1/2 tsp Sea salt
recipes.instructions:
1. Preheat your oven to 180°C (350°F) and grease a standard loaf tin.
2. In a large mixing bowl, beat the eggs with the water and avocado oil until pale and frothy.
3. Add the ground flaxseed, baking powder, and salt to the wet ingredients.
4. Use a spatula to fold the dry ingredients in until no clumps remain. Let the batter sit for 5 minutes; it will thicken significantly.
5. Pour the batter into the loaf tin and smooth the top with a wet spoon.
6. Bake for 45 minutes, or until the top is firm and a toothpick comes out clean.
7. Allow to cool completely on a wire rack before slicing to prevent crumbling.

recipes.title: Low-Sugar Almond Cookies
recipes.ingredients:
• 150g Fine Almond Flour
• 1 Large Egg
• 2 tbsp Erythritol
• 1/2 tsp Vanilla Extract
• 1/4 tsp Salt
recipes.instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 170°C and line a tray with parchment.
2. Cream the egg, erythritol, and vanilla in a bowl until combined.
3. Stir in the almond flour and salt until a dough forms.
4. Roll into 10 equal balls and flatten slightly on the tray.
5. Bake for 12 minutes until the edges are just starting to turn golden brown.
6. Cool on the tray for 10 minutes to allow them to firm up.

recipes.title: Dark Chocolate Avocado Mousse
recipes.ingredients:
• 1 large Ripe Avocado
• 3 tbsp Unsweetened Cocoa Powder
• 3 tbsp Erythritol (powdered)
• 50ml Unsweetened Almond Milk
• 1/2 tsp Vanilla Extract
recipes.instructions:
1. Scoop the avocado flesh into a high-speed blender or food processor.
2. Add the cocoa powder, erythritol, and vanilla extract.
3. Begin blending on low speed, slowly drizzling in the almond milk until the mixture becomes silky and smooth.
4. Scrape down the sides of the processor and blend once more for 30 seconds.
5. Divide the mousse into two glass bowls.
6. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving to allow the flavors to meld and the texture to set.

recipes.title: Fudgy Keto Brownies
recipes.ingredients:
• 150g Sugar-free Dark Chocolate (min 85%)
• 100g Unsalted Butter
• 100g Granulated Erythritol
• 50g Almond Flour
• 2 Large Eggs
• 1/2 tsp Baking Powder
recipes.instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 170°C and grease a square 8x8 inch baking tin.
2. Melt the chocolate and butter together using a bain-marie (bowl over simmering water).
3. Once melted, whisk in the erythritol and let cool slightly.
4. Beat in the eggs one at a time until the batter is glossy.
5. Gently fold in the almond flour and baking powder until just combined.
6. Pour into the tin and bake for 20-22 minutes. The center should still be slightly soft.
7. Cool completely in the tin before cutting into 9 squares.
